issues.title: Bank of Korea Raises Base Rate to 3.25%, Lifts Next Year's Growth Forecast to 4.1%
issues.titleKo: 한국은행, 기준금리 3.25%로 인상…내년 성장률 전망은 4.1%로 상향
issues.summary: The Bank of Korea raised its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage point, from 3.00 percent to 3.25 percent, on the 26th. Reflecting the semiconductor boom, it also sharply lifted its growth forecast for next year from 2.9 percent to 4.1 percent.
issues.why: Interest costs on floating-rate loans and on student, jeonse and monthly-rent financing could rise, and the economic outlook also shapes the mood of the job market.

paragraphs.en: The Bank of Korea's Monetary Policy Board raised the base rate by 0.25 percentage point, from 3.00 percent to 3.25 percent, on the 26th. The decision came at the board's final policy meeting of this year. The central bank had raised rates twice, in July and August, and the latest move resumes the tightening after a three-month pause, making it the third increase in the second half alone. The base rate is now at its highest level in about two years, since November 2024.
paragraphs.ko: 한국은행 금융통화위원회가 26일 기준금리를 연 3.00%에서 3.25%로 0.25%포인트 올렸습니다. 올해 마지막 통화정책방향 회의에서 나온 결정입니다. 한은은 7월과 8월에 두 차례 금리를 올렸고, 이번에 3개월 만에 인상을 재개해 하반기에만 세 번째 인상이 됐습니다. 기준금리는 2024년 11월 이후 약 2년 만에 가장 높은 수준입니다.

paragraphs.en: On the same day, the central bank released its revised economic outlook. It raised its growth forecast for next year by 1.2 percentage points, from 2.9 percent to 4.1 percent, and lifted this year's estimate from 3.3 percent to 3.9 percent. The upgrade for next year is the largest since the bank began publishing next-year growth forecasts in December 2008. If the forecast holds, it would be the first growth rate in the 4 percent range since 2021. The bank's research department cited rising exports and investment driven by demand for AI investment, as well as a consumption recovery supported by better income conditions and increased fiscal spending.

issues.title: Police Seek Arrest Warrant for Top Scorer in AI-Aided Tax Accountant Exam Cheating as TOEIC Tightens Security
issues.titleKo: 경찰, AI로 세무사 시험 부정행위 한 수석 합격자 구속영장 신청…토익도 감독 강화
issues.summary: Police on the 26th applied for an arrest warrant for a man surnamed Han, the top scorer on the tax accountant exam who turned himself in for cheating with AI. The National Assembly's education committee will hear a report on follow-up measures to the college entrance exam on the 27th, and TOEIC will tighten controls starting with its exam on the 29th.
issues.why: As cheating with AI devices keeps surfacing, changes to proctoring methods and rules on what test-takers may bring directly affect college students sitting for exams where fairness matters, such as the CSAT, certification tests and TOEIC.

paragraphs.en: The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency's public crime investigation unit applied on the 26th for an arrest warrant, on charges including obstruction of official duties, for a man surnamed Han, 34, who placed first on the tax accountant exam. Han admitted to cheating with AI and turned himself in, submitting a written confession to the agency on the 15th. Police reportedly view the case as one with a large social impact because it undermined the fairness of a national exam.
paragraphs.ko: 서울경찰청 광역수사단 공공범죄수사대는 26일 공무집행방해 등의 혐의로 세무사 시험 수석 합격자 한모(34) 씨에 대한 구속영장을 신청했습니다. 한 씨는 AI를 이용해 부정행위를 했다고 인정하고 지난 15일 서울경찰청에 자수서를 냈습니다. 경찰은 국가시험의 공정성을 해친 사안이라 사회적 파장이 크다고 본 것으로 전해졌습니다.

paragraphs.en: Police reportedly judged that there is a risk of evidence destruction and flight even though Han turned himself in, noting that some of the electronic devices he submitted as having been used in the crime were damaged. According to a report he filed with the exam authorities, Han used a miniature camera, a smartphone and a modified calculator. Questions photographed by a camera hidden in correction tape were sent to a laptop at his home, and answers generated by generative AI on the laptop came back to a tiny monitor.
paragraphs.ko: 경찰은 한 씨가 자수했더라도 범행에 썼다며 제출한 전자기기 일부가 파손된 점을 들어 증거인멸과 도주 우려가 있다고 판단한 것으로 알려졌습니다. 시험 관계기관에 낸 경위서에 따르면 한 씨는 초소형 카메라, 스마트폰, 개조한 계산기를 이용했습니다. 수정테이프 속 카메라로 찍은 문제가 자택 노트북으로 전송되고, 노트북의 생성형 AI가 만든 답이 초소형 모니터로 돌아오는 방식이었습니다.

paragraphs.en: Similar problems have continued on the college entrance exam, known as the CSAT. The Education Ministry said on the 19th that 98 people had been caught cheating as of the end of the fourth period of the 2027 CSAT, and 49 of them were detected through emergency disaster alerts. Former Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin recently stepped down, citing poor management of measures to prevent cheating on the exam, among other reasons.
paragraphs.ko: 수능에서도 비슷한 문제가 이어졌습니다. 교육부는 지난 19일 2027학년도 수능 4교시 종료 기준으로 부정행위자가 98명이라고 밝혔고, 이 가운데 49명은 위급재난문자를 통해 적발됐습니다. 최교진 전 교육부 장관은 수능 부정행위 방지 대책 관리 부실 등을 이유로 최근 사퇴했습니다.

paragraphs.en: On the 27th, the National Assembly's Education Committee will hold a plenary session to hear a report from Vice Education Minister Choi Eun-ok on follow-up measures to the CSAT, including how to respond to AI cheating. A bill to amend the Higher Education Act, which would lengthen the suspension of eligibility to take the CSAT from the current one year to three, five or 10 years, will also be put on the agenda. Some of the amendments would apply retroactively starting with this year's exam. The Korea TOEIC Committee also said that from its regular exam on the 29th it will add six more measures, including checking every pair of glasses, attaching security seals, introducing radio-wave detectors, banning mechanical pencils and banning hats.

issues.summary: The Korean Railway Workers' Union began a safety-driving campaign at 9 a.m. on the 26th, halting four conventional trains and delaying 235 commuter trains by more than 20 minutes. The action is set to continue through Dec. 4.
issues.why: College students who commute by rail, or who have essay tests, interviews or trips home planned, could be directly affected by train delays and suspensions.

paragraphs.en: The Korean Railway Workers' Union began a campaign of safety-focused operations at 9 a.m. on the 26th, demanding improvements to the promotion system, additional allowances and more staff. Rather than stopping work as in a strike, members strictly follow work rules and operating regulations. Train drivers do not speed up delayed trains to make up lost time, and they do not send out a train if they spot a problem during pre-departure checks.
paragraphs.ko: 전국철도노동조합은 승진 제도 개선, 추가 수당 지급, 인력 확충을 요구하며 26일 오전 9시부터 안전운행 투쟁에 들어갔습니다. 파업처럼 일을 멈추는 대신 작업 수칙과 운행 규정을 빠짐없이 지키는 방식입니다. 기관사들은 지연된 열차의 속도를 높여 만회하는 회복 운전을 하지 않고, 출고 전 점검에서 이상이 보이면 열차를 내보내지 않습니다.

sents.en: The Korean Railway Workers' Union began a campaign of safety-focused operations at 9 a.m. on the 26th, demanding improvements to the promotion system, additional allowances and more staff.
sents.ko: 전국철도노동조합은 승진 제도 개선, 추가 수당 지급, 인력 확충을 요구하며 26일 오전 9시부터 안전운행 투쟁에 들어갔습니다.

sents.en: Rather than stopping work as in a strike, members strictly follow work rules and operating regulations.

sents.en: Train drivers do not speed up delayed trains to make up lost time, and they do not send out a train if they spot a problem during pre-departure checks.

paragraphs.en: According to Korail, as of 5 p.m., four conventional trains had stopped running, four conventional trains were running more than 30 minutes late, and 235 commuter trains were more than 20 minutes late. No KTX trains were delayed by more than 20 minutes. A Mugunghwa train bound for Yeosu, scheduled to leave Yongsan at 3:10 p.m., was canceled after its departure from the depot was delayed by more than an hour, and 431 passengers turned back. There was no major disruption during the morning rush, but delays grew during the evening commute, and a Busan-bound Mugunghwa train was nearly an hour late at Daejeon Station.

The action runs through Dec. 4, and if its demands are not met, the union plans to launch an indefinite general strike at 9 a.m. on Dec. 10.

issues.title: Trump Says He Urged Putin to Stop Military Aggression Across Europe
issues.titleKo: 트럼프, 푸틴에게 유럽 전역 군사 공격 중단 요구했다고 밝혀
issues.summary: President Donald Trump said on the 26th that he demanded President Vladimir Putin halt military aggression across Europe when they met recently in China. He and the NATO secretary-general, whom he met the previous day, jointly urged Russia to avoid escalating the war.
issues.why: The course of the war in Ukraine affects European security and the global energy supply and economy, so it is also linked to the daily lives of South Korean college students.

paragraphs.en: In a post on the social media platform Truth Social on the 26th, local time, President Donald Trump said he had demanded that President Vladimir Putin stop military aggression across Europe when they met in China recently. He said he wants an agreement between Russia and Ukraine to be reached quickly and spent a lot of time conveying that message. Trump stressed that he believes a deal to end the war is well within reach and that it would be a great gift to everyone if it came together.
paragraphs.ko: 도널드 트럼프 대통령은 26일(현지시간) 소셜미디어 트루스소셜에서 최근 중국에서 푸틴 대통령을 만났을 때 유럽 전역에 대한 군사적 침략 행위를 멈추라고 요구했다고 밝혔습니다. 러시아와 우크라이나 사이의 합의가 빨리 이뤄지기를 바라며 이를 전하는 데 많은 시간을 썼다고 했습니다. 종전 합의는 충분히 실현 가능하다고 믿으며 이뤄지면 모두에게 큰 선물이 될 것이라고 강조했습니다.

paragraphs.en: Trump said he met NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte at his Mar-a-Lago home in Florida the previous evening and shared the content of his talks with Putin. In a joint statement, the two said they discussed the importance of avoiding actions that escalate the war, whether intended or not, and of finding a peaceful resolution as soon as possible.
paragraphs.ko: 트럼프 대통령은 전날 저녁 플로리다 마러라고 자택에서 마르크 뤼터 나토 사무총장을 만나 푸틴 대통령과의 회담 내용을 공유했다고 했습니다. 두 사람은 공동 성명에서 러시아가 의도했든 아니든 전쟁을 확대하는 행동을 피하고, 가능한 한 빨리 평화적 해결책을 찾는 것이 중요하다고 논의했다고 밝혔습니다.

paragraphs.en: Trump met Putin in Shenzhen, China, on the 19th, and afterward relayed that Putin wants to end the war through diplomacy. Concern arose in Europe after he called Putin a friend. Rutte said Trump is testing Putin's willingness to negotiate and that it is working. Yonhap News Agency reported that the post is also interpreted as an attempt to reassure European allies.

issues.title: Olive Young Work System Hacked, Personal Data of 790 Employees and Customers Leaked
issues.titleKo: 올리브영 업무시스템 해킹, 임직원·고객 790명 개인정보 유출
issues.summary: CJ Olive Young said on the 26th that its work system was accessed without authorization on the 23rd and that the personal information of 790 people was leaked. The company said payment information and passwords were not exposed.
issues.why: Olive Young is a service college students often use, so knowing which items were exposed and the warning to watch for impersonation texts and emails can help you protect your own information.

paragraphs.en: CJ Olive Young said in a notice on its website on the 26th that its work system had been hacked and that personal information of some employees and customers had been leaked. The company explained that there was unauthorized external access on the 23rd and that it confirmed some of the personal information contained in certain data had been leaked.
paragraphs.ko: CJ올리브영은 26일 홈페이지 공지를 통해 업무 시스템이 해킹돼 임직원과 고객 일부의 개인정보가 유출됐다고 밝혔습니다. 회사는 지난 23일 외부의 비인가 접근이 있었고, 일부 자료에 포함된 개인정보 일부가 유출된 것을 확인했다고 설명했습니다.

sents.ko: CJ올리브영은 26일 홈페이지 공지를 통해 업무 시스템이 해킹돼 임직원과 고객 일부의 개인정보가 유출됐다고 밝혔습니다.

sents.en: The company explained that there was unauthorized external access on the 23rd and that it confirmed some of the personal information contained in certain data had been leaked.
sents.ko: 회사는 지난 23일 외부의 비인가 접근이 있었고, 일부 자료에 포함된 개인정보 일부가 유출된 것을 확인했다고 설명했습니다.

paragraphs.en: A total of 790 people were affected: 639 employees, 106 people from partner companies and 45 general customers. Membership numbers were leaked for all 790, and for some, names, IP addresses, member IDs, phone numbers, dates of birth and email addresses were leaked as well. The company said payment information and passwords were not leaked.
paragraphs.ko: 유출된 인원은 모두 790명으로, 임직원이 639명, 협력사 관계자가 106명, 일반 고객이 45명입니다. 790명 모두 회원번호가 유출됐고, 일부는 성명, IP, 회원ID, 전화번호, 생년월일, 이메일주소도 함께 유출됐습니다. 회사는 결제 정보와 비밀번호는 유출되지 않았다고 밝혔습니다.

sents.en: Membership numbers were leaked for all 790, and for some, names, IP addresses, member IDs, phone numbers, dates of birth and email addresses were leaked as well.

issues.summary: North Korea's Korean Central News Agency reported on Nov. 26 that leader Kim Jong-un visited a weapons-grade nuclear material production base, a nuclear propulsion equipment base and a nuclear weapons institute. South Korea's Defense Ministry said Pyongyang should immediately stop trying to justify its nuclear development.
issues.why: North Korea disclosed nuclear-related facilities and equipment all at once and made remarks aimed at South Korea, which is important for understanding the security situation on the Korean Peninsula.

paragraphs.en: North Korea's Korean Central News Agency reported on Nov. 26 that Kim Jong-un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission, had visited three sites the day before. They were a weapons-grade nuclear material production base, a production base for nuclear propulsion equipment and a nuclear weapons institute. It was the first time the existence of the base for nuclear propulsion equipment had become known. Photos released showed cylindrical equipment believed to be a reactor for a nuclear-powered submarine, and experts said it could be equipment for the nuclear-powered submarine the North is building.

issues.title: University Council's Regular Admissions Fair Set for Dec. 11-13 at COEX With 125 Universities Taking Part
issues.titleKo: 대교협 정시 박람회 12월 11~13일 코엑스에서 열려, 125개 대학 참가
issues.summary: The Korean Council for University Education will hold the 2027 regular admissions university information fair at COEX in Seoul from Dec. 11 to 13. A total of 125 four-year universities nationwide will take part and offer one-on-one counseling with admissions experts.
issues.why: The event coincides with the release of CSAT scores, so it helps test-takers planning regular admissions applications and university students curious about admissions trends.

paragraphs.en: The Korean Council for University Education will hold the 2027 regular admissions university information fair from Dec. 11 to 13 in Hall A on the first floor of COEX in Samseong-dong, Seoul. A total of 125 four-year universities nationwide will take part, and the event is timed to coincide with the day College Scholastic Ability Test scores are released. Operating hours are 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on the 11th and 12th, and 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. on the 13th.

issues.title: New U.S. Overcapacity Tariff Plan Keeps 15% Cap for South Korea, but Average Rate Would Rise to 13.9%
issues.titleKo: 미국 새 과잉생산 관세안, 한국은 15% 상한 유지되지만 미국 평균 관세율은 13.9%로 오를 전망
issues.summary: The Office of the U.S. Trade Representative proposed additional tariffs on 14 economies, including South Korea, China, Japan and the EU, citing overcapacity. South Korea keeps the 15 percent cap under its existing deal, but if carried out, the average U.S. tariff rate would rise to 13.9 percent.
issues.why: Autos, semiconductors and petrochemicals, South Korea's main export industries, were named as overcapacity sectors, so the news is worth watching for university students considering jobs in those fields.

paragraphs.en: The Office of the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) announced on Nov. 25 local time the results of its industrial overcapacity investigation under Section 301 of the Trade Act. It proposed additional tariffs on 14 economies, including South Korea, China, Japan and the European Union (EU). For those that have trade deals, such as South Korea, Japan and the EU, it proposed keeping the 15 percent cap under existing agreements. For China, it proposed up to 20 percent.
paragraphs.ko: 미국 무역대표부(USTR)는 현지 시간 11월 25일 무역법 301조에 따른 산업 과잉생산 조사 결과를 발표했어요. 한국, 중국, 일본, 유럽연합(EU) 등 14개 경제 주체에 추가 관세를 매기는 방안을 내놓았어요. 한국·일본·EU처럼 무역 합의를 맺은 곳에는 기존 합의에 따른 15% 상한을 유지하는 안을 제시했어요. 중국에는 최대 20%를 제시했어요.

sents.en: The Office of the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) announced on Nov. 25 local time the results of its industrial overcapacity investigation under Section 301 of the Trade Act.
sents.ko: 미국 무역대표부(USTR)는 현지 시간 11월 25일 무역법 301조에 따른 산업 과잉생산 조사 결과를 발표했어요.

sents.en: For those that have trade deals, such as South Korea, Japan and the EU, it proposed keeping the 15 percent cap under existing agreements.
sents.ko: 한국·일본·EU처럼 무역 합의를 맺은 곳에는 기존 합의에 따른 15% 상한을 유지하는 안을 제시했어요.

sents.en: For China, it proposed up to 20 percent.
sents.ko: 중국에는 최대 20%를 제시했어요.

paragraphs.en: The Budget Lab at Yale University estimated that if the plan is carried out, the average effective U.S. tariff rate would rise from the current 11.2 percent to 13.9 percent. That is nearly the same as the 13.8 percent just before the Supreme Court struck down reciprocal tariffs based on the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) in February this year. The lab analyzed that the current tariffs alone raise U.S. consumer prices by about 0.6 percent and cost each household about $900 more a year.
paragraphs.ko: 미국 예일대 예산연구소는 이 방안이 시행되면 미국의 평균 실효 관세율이 현재 11.2%에서 13.9%로 오른다고 추산했어요. 올해 2월 연방대법원이 IEEPA에 근거한 상호관세를 무효화하기 직전의 13.8%와 거의 같은 수준이에요. 연구소는 현행 관세만으로도 미국 소비자물가가 약 0.6% 오르고 가구당 연간 약 900달러를 더 부담한다고 분석했어요.

sents.en: The Budget Lab at Yale University estimated that if the plan is carried out, the average effective U.S. tariff rate would rise from the current 11.2 percent to 13.9 percent.
sents.ko: 미국 예일대 예산연구소는 이 방안이 시행되면 미국의 평균 실효 관세율이 현재 11.2%에서 13.9%로 오른다고 추산했어요.

paragraphs.en: In South Korea's case, the USTR named autos, petrochemicals and semiconductors as sectors of structural overcapacity and directly mentioned the government-backed semiconductor cluster project in the Honam region. South Korea's trade surplus with the United States from January to October this year reached $102.3 billion, topping $100 billion for the first time. The United States also warned that 25 percent instead of 15 percent could apply to South Korea if the results of consultations or earlier commitments are unsatisfactory.
paragraphs.ko: 한국에서는 USTR이 자동차, 석유화학, 반도체를 구조적 과잉생산 분야로 꼽고 정부가 추진하는 호남권 반도체 클러스터 사업을 직접 언급했어요. 올해 1~10월 대미 무역흑자는 1,023억 달러로 처음 1,000억 달러를 넘었어요. 협의나 기존 약속의 결과가 만족스럽지 않으면 한국에 15% 대신 25%가 적용될 수 있다고 미국이 예고했어요.

paragraphs.en: Trade Minister Kim Jung-kwan said that merely keeping the existing 15 percent cap was a solid result. China's Ministry of Commerce said on Nov. 26 that it firmly opposes the move as unilateralism. The USTR plans to accept written comments until Jan. 5, 2027, and to finalize tariff rates after a public hearing on Jan. 25.

issues.title: Samsung Electronics Unifies Memory Development Under the Head of Its Memory Business
issues.titleKo: 삼성전자, 메모리 개발 조직을 메모리사업부장 직속으로 일원화
issues.summary: Samsung Electronics' chip division reorganized on the 26th, placing its DRAM, flash and solutions development offices directly under the head of the Memory Business. The System LSI Business also re-established a strategy and marketing office that merges its sales and marketing units.
issues.why: Semiconductors are a mainstay of the Korean economy, so how Samsung reshapes its development structure for the AI era offers a clue to jobs and the broader economic outlook.

paragraphs.en: Samsung Electronics' Device Solutions (DS) division finalized a reorganization alongside a follow-up executive reshuffle. It scrapped the post of head of memory development and placed the DRAM, flash and solutions development offices directly under the head of the Memory Business. Hwang Sang-joon, who leads the business, will also serve as head of DRAM development, a move seen as a way to oversee next-generation memory development personally.
paragraphs.ko: 삼성전자 DS부문은 후속 임원 인사와 함께 조직 개편을 확정했어요. 메모리개발담당 직책을 없애고 D램개발실, 플래시개발실, 솔루션개발실을 메모리사업부장 직속으로 바꿨어요. 황상준 사업부장은 D램개발실장을 겸직하며, 차세대 메모리 개발을 직접 챙기려는 것으로 풀이돼요.

issues.title: Constitutional Court Strikes Down Ban on Third-Party Intervention in Labor Disputes
issues.titleKo: 헌재, 노동쟁의 제3자 개입금지 조항에 위헌 결정
issues.summary: The Constitutional Court ruled on the 26th that an old labor law provision barring third parties from intervening in labor disputes, and punishing violations, is unconstitutional. The decision overturns rulings in 1990 and 1993 that upheld the provision, reversing course after 33 years.
issues.why: Because the ruling re-examines an old labor law provision against the Constitution, it helps explain how far workers' rights to organize and take collective action are guaranteed.

paragraphs.en: The Constitutional Court on the 26th ruled unconstitutional the ban on third-party intervention found in the former Labor Dispute Adjustment Act and related laws. The provision barred third parties from intervening in labor disputes and imposed punishment on those who did. In the two cases referred for review of constitutionality, six justices found it unconstitutional and three found it constitutional.

sents.en: The provision barred third parties from intervening in labor disputes and imposed punishment on those who did.

paragraphs.en: The case stemmed from a retrial. A man surnamed Yoon, a former head of the Daewoo Precision union, and former lawmaker Hong Young-pyo were each sentenced to prison in 1991 for issuing statements backing a strike although they were not workers at Daewoo Shipbuilding. The two requested a retrial in 2022, and the Seoul Central District Court handling it asked the Constitutional Court to decide whether the provision was constitutional.

paragraphs.en: The majority opinion held that the provision broadly bans and punishes third-party intervention with no limit on method or target. It said this could punish even acts that do not harm workers' autonomous decisions, as well as assistance in exercising the three basic labor rights. The court concluded that the exercise of those rights is greatly curtailed and that the provision violates the principle of proportionality. issues.summary: An attack on a refinery in Jazan, southern Saudi Arabia, killed one worker and briefly halted some operations, Saudi state news agency SPA reported on the 26th. The Saudi-led coalition blamed Yemen's Houthis and warned of a firm military response.
issues.why: Attacks on Middle Eastern oil facilities can shake global oil prices and energy costs, which in turn connect to prices in Korea, an oil importer.

Citing an Energy Ministry official, Saudi state news agency SPA reported on the 26th local time that the dead worker was a Nepali national and that several workers of various nationalities were injured and receiving treatment. A fire broke out in the attack, and some operations at the facility were temporarily halted.

issues.titleKo: 땅속 통신 광섬유를 지진계로 활용해 작은 지진의 파열 과정을 포착한 국내 연구진
issues.summary: A team led by Seoul National University professor Kim Young-hee used telecommunications optical fiber to reconstruct the fault rupture of a magnitude 2 earthquake at a resolution of one-thousandth of a second. The findings were published in the 27th issue of the journal Science.
issues.why: Because optical fiber is laid densely across Korea, it could supplement the country's seismic monitoring network and move everyday earthquake preparedness technology a step forward.

paragraphs.en: The Ministry of Science and ICT announced that a team led by Kim Young-hee, a professor in the School of Earth and Environmental Sciences at Seoul National University, used underground telecommunications fiber to reconstruct the fault rupture of a small earthquake at a resolution of one-thousandth of a second. The findings appeared in the 27th issue of the international journal Science.

sents.en: The Ministry of Science and ICT announced that a team led by Kim Young-hee, a professor in the School of Earth and Environmental Sciences at Seoul National University, used underground telecommunications fiber to reconstruct the fault rupture of a small earthquake at a resolution of one-thousandth of a second.

sents.en: The findings appeared in the 27th issue of the international journal Science.
sents.ko: 연구 결과는 국제학술지 사이언스 27일자에 실렸어요.

paragraphs.en: The technology used is distributed acoustic sensing (DAS). It fires a laser into an optical fiber and measures changes in the light reflected back, relying on the way seismic waves slightly stretch and compress the fiber.
